feature: Truncate stored monetary fractions; explicitly supersedes half-up
authority: User explicitly requests stored values cut toward zero and asks to continue

policy.rule: input/unit price and component monetary results truncate toward zero; derived totals from truncated source; recorded paid/APM cut, not replaced by a new transfer

migrations.order: data after kasbon and before BIGINT; pending data migration also runs when type migration is already recorded
migrations.before_after: encrypted with unchanged APP_KEY; patch hash
migrations.rollback: refuse when converted audit or new-policy documents exist

coverage: SQL and matching active JSON money conversion
late SQL failure rollback of money/audit/revision and retry
fresh migration before type migration; populated conversion fixture after type migration
sub-rupiah positive amount refuses before UPDATE

query_review.lookup_strategy: indexed relationships; no per-record account/private-file/catalog reads
query_review.write_cost: scales with changed records and encrypted audit rows
query_review.workspace_columns: id only for plan; id and revision for apply lock; archived state never selected

limits: MySQL/MariaDB DDL and remote deployment not verified
Browser account, responsive, keyboard, Word and physical print not verified
Conflicting active kasbon/payment sums or positive-to-zero amounts require reconciliation before conversion
Bank transfer and original proof remain external/manual and unchanged
Maintenance must exclude other writers; MySQL DDL is not fully transactional
